metadata.name: UK Legal Data Agent Hackathon Challenge
metadata.description: Focused seven-question evaluation set for the participant diagnose-change-retest exercise.

evaluation_queries.question: How many active clients do we have?
evaluation_queries.paraphrase: What is our current active customer count?
evaluation_queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base_customers WHERE status = 'Active'

evaluation_queries.question: What is the total value of all matters?
evaluation_queries.paraphrase: What is our complete case portfolio worth?

evaluation_queries.question: How much revenue have we generated?
evaluation_queries.paraphrase: What is the total amount invoiced?
evaluation_queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM(amount_gbp) FROM base_transactions WHERE transaction_type = 'Invoice'

evaluation_queries.question: How many invoices remain unpaid?
evaluation_queries.paraphrase: What is our unpaid invoice count?
evaluation_queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base_transactions WHERE transaction_type = 'Invoice' AND payment_status = 'Unpaid'

evaluation_queries.question: How many legal cases are currently open?
evaluation_queries.paraphrase: How many open matters are on our books?
evaluation_queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base_cases WHERE case_status = 'Open'

evaluation_queries.question: How many customers do we have?
evaluation_queries.paraphrase: What is our total client count?

evaluation_queries.question: Find count of customers with no interactions in the last 60 days but with unpaid invoices over 10000.
evaluation_queries.paraphrase: How many customers have had no interaction in the past 60 days and have more than GBP 10,000 in unpaid invoices?
evaluation_queries.ground_truth_sql: WITH unpaid_by_customer AS (SELECT c.customer_id, SUM(t.amount_gbp) AS unpaid_invoice_amount FROM base_cases c JOIN base_transactions t ON t.case_id = c.case_id WHERE t.transaction_type = 'Invoice' AND t.payment_status = 'Unpaid' GROUP BY c.customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM unpaid_by_customer u WHERE u.unpaid_invoice_amount > 10000 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM base_interactions i WHERE i.customer_id = u.customer_id AND i.interaction_date >= DATEADD(day, -60, CAST(GETDATE() AS date)))
evaluation_queries.notes: Unpaid invoices means the per-customer sum of Invoice transactions whose payment_status is exactly Unpaid. The 60-day window is relative to the evaluation date. The checked-in interactions end on 2023-12-31, so the expected count is 35 for evaluations run after 2024-02-29.
